passiveWatchPolicy: Never select or mark mastery from watch completion alone; only checkpoint, assessment, project, or instructor-reviewed evidence may affect mastery.

modes.when: No mastery evidence exists for the objective or confidence is below 0.20.
modes.teacherAction: Assign the full generated lecture with checkpoints and citations.

modes.when: The learner has some evidence, no unresolved misconception, and needs focused review.
modes.teacherAction: Assign the most relevant chapter or checkpoint segment rather than the full lecture.

modes.when: The learner has some evidence and accommodations or preferences favor low-distraction text-first review.
modes.teacherAction: Assign transcript-first study with citations and checkpoint prompts.

modes.when: A misconception or failed checkpoint is unresolved for the objective.
modes.teacherAction: Assign the misconception-check or remediation segment before more practice.
